description.en: Sets how the ball should be put back into play for a restart (e.g. kickoff, throw-in, corner or goal kick), by a numeric restart-type ID.
Numeric ID identifying the kind of restart to use.
True once the restart type has been applied; null if no restartType argument was given.

example.code:
// Set up the ball restart for this match's kickoff
CMND_BTL_SET_RESTART_BALL(1);
